change_summary: Replaced the transposed [BLOCK_N, BLOCK_K] weight load + tl.trans() with a direct [BLOCK_K, BLOCK_N] weight load (offs_k as outer dim via in_c[:,None]/kh[:,None]/kw[:,None], offs_n as inner dim), and changed tl.dot(x_tile, tl.trans(w_tile_T), acc) to tl.dot(x_tile, w_tile, acc) to eliminate uncoalesced shared/global memory access.
